_comment: Hand-set fixes keyed by the company key (lowercase alphanumerics, see normaliseKey in src/shared/headline.ts). Fields: domain, board {provider, slug, url}, careersUrl, noBoard (resolver found somebody else's board), exclude (not an Indian startup). Anything here beats what the resolver finds.

piston._why: Name-only lookup lands on piston.com (Piston Technologies, US). The Indian cardless-payments Piston has no findable site yet.

homerun._why: Name-only lookup lands on homerun.co, a Dutch ATS vendor. The Indian construction-materials HomeRun is not it.

diageo._why: Diageo India is a listed multinational, not a startup.

space._why: "Space." is Future plc's space.com; the headline was about the sector.

built._why: Name-only lookup cannot find the Inc42 'AI Infra Play, BUILT' company; the site it landed on is not it.

sarvam._why: The key migration kept the record whose domain was sarvam.co.in (a different Sarvam). The AI company is sarvam.ai; its Ashby board was verified by hand.
